description: This file defines the class 'Image_Graph_Plot_BoxWhisker' which implements a box and whisker plot for the PEAR PHP OO Graph Rendering Utility. It includes methods for drawing vertical and horizontal box plots, setting whisker size, and rendering the plot.

classes.name: Image_Graph_Plot_BoxWhisker
classes.description: Class for rendering box and whisker charts within the PEAR Image_Graph package.

methods.name: _drawBoxWhiskerV
methods.description: Draws a vertical box and whisker plot with circles, lines, and rectangle for quartiles.

methods.name: _drawBoxWhiskerH
methods.description: Draws a horizontal box and whisker plot with circles, lines, and rectangle for quartiles.

methods.name: _drawLegendSample
methods.description: Draws a sample box and whisker representation for the legend.

methods.name: setWhiskerSize
methods.description: Sets the size (radius) of the whisker circles/dots.

methods.name: _done
methods.description: Performs the drawing of the entire box and whisker plot on the canvas.
